headline: Kernex Microsystems files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Kernex Microsystems has submitted its annual general meeting scrutinizer report and voting results to the stock exchanges. The filing follows the company's AGM held on September 30, 2026. This is a routine corporate compliance filing for listed entities. Retail shareholders can review the final voting outcomes on the exchange portals.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no immediate financial impact.
